title: cadintent scope declaration
description: The blast radius a submission claims before it lands: a mandatory, non-empty list of typed terms with union semantics, resolved against the submission's declared head. Whole-project scope is always a deliberate term, never a default. Spec version 0.1.0.

ObjectScopeTerm.description: One object by ULID — including a ULID minted within this submission.

SelectionScopeTerm.description: A selection by ULID, with an optional '#group' suffix. Resolved against the pre-state at the declared head — a submission cannot widen its own scope.

NetworkScopeTerm.description: A network by ULID: covers pre-state members, objects the submission itself makes members, and the network object itself.

RegionScopeTerm.description: A closed polyline in project plan coordinates: covers objects whose pre- or post-state geometry intersects it.

ProjectScopeTerm.description: The explicit whole-project term. Deliberate and visible in the record — totality costs a keystroke.

ScopeTerm.description: One typed scope term. A touched object is in scope if it matches any term.

ScopeDeclaration.description: The submission's scope declaration: mandatory and non-empty.
